answers.label: Benefits and challenges of consequential methods
answers.text:
・We support introducing consequential accounting. This will make visible the social GHG avoided emissions from corporate renewable energy procurement and power projects (including CHP), thereby promoting corporate renewable energy procurement and accelerating carbon neutrality.
・We think it is needed to prepare data preparation, such as data for marginal emission factors, is necessary for calculation.

answers.label: Appropriateness of the TWG subgroup formula
Why the formula is or is not appropriate
answers.text:
・We agree with the formula using marginal emission rate to determine avoided emissions, which is proposed by Sub-group. Marginal emission rate ensures the social avoided emissions contribution of renewable energy procurement is appropriately evaluated.
・However, I oppose netting. Netting subtracts avoided emissions from the inventory, which violates GHG Protocol principles (inventory accounting and project accounting are distinct and should be reported separately).
We suggest that induced emissions and avoided emissions should be reported separately, and the decision to apply netting should be determined by each system, program, or initiative, including whether they authorize it.

answers.label: Secondary effects to consider, and how
answers.text: By procuring renewable energy, companies contribute to societal GHG reduction. Properly evaluating such secondary effects can promote corporate renewable energy procurement and accelerate carbon neutrality.

answers.label: Why annual or lifetime reporting
answers.text: The marginal emission rate used in calculations may change annually, therefore, to ensure greater accuracy, it should be reported annually.

answers.label: Why selected tests should be included
answers.text: Considering avoided emissions, even when procuring renewable energy that lacks additionality, it contributes to societal GHG reductions; therefore, additionality requirements should not be imposed.

answers.label: Details on operating margin methodologies
answers.text: In general, thermal power sources adjust fluctuations in grid demand, and renewable energy replaces thermal power sources. So, the operational margin should be the emission rates of the thermal power sources to be replaced.

answers.label: Details on build margin methodologies
answers.text: The introduction of renewable energy is significantly influenced by the policies and systems of individual countries, so basing the build margin on policy scenarios has a certain degree of rationality.

answers.label: Why that spatial granularity ceiling
answers.text: In Japan, data by government is the most well-organized and is used in various systems.

answers.label: Why that temporal granularity ceiling
answers.text: In Japan, annual data is the most well-organized and is used in various systems.
